guides.title: 工程檔案：關鍵數據、年代、規範與案例
guides.titleEn: Engineering dossier: key figures, timeline, codes and landmarks
guides.concept: 連結內襯幾何、固化證據與長期外壓及水理效能。本頁區分公開工程資料與明示的教學假設；數值只用於學習比較，不是設計值。
guides.conceptEn: Connect liner geometry and cure evidence with long term external pressure and hydraulic performance. This dossier distinguishes public project facts from explicitly labelled teaching assumptions; figures are for learning comparisons, not design values.
facts: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設量得有效厚度6mm、參照原厚10mm，保留比例6/10=0.60即60%；這不是保留60%承載力，也不代表滿足最小設計厚度。
教學假設，非現場設定值：假設E=3000MPa、ν=0.30、t/D=0.01，pcr=2E/(1−ν²)(t/D)³=0.00659MPa=6.59kPa；這不是實際管線的許可外壓。
教學假設，非現場設定值：取內壓p=0.6MPa、直徑D=0.3m、厚t=0.006m，σθ=pD/(2t)=15MPa；需使用一致長度單位，並另查材料長期允許應力。
教學假設，非現場設定值：同材料其他條件固定時，厚度由6mm降為5mm，彎曲剛度比Dnew/Dold=(5/6)³=0.579，即約保留57.9%；D在此指板彎曲剛度。
教學假設，非現場設定值：假設未固化總反應焓Htotal=200J/g、試片殘餘焓Hres=20J/g，轉化率α=1−Hres/Htotal=0.90；兩者須同配方及相容測試程序。
教學假設，非現場設定值：假設短期模數Eshort=3000MPa、對應設計時間的長期模數Elong=1500MPa，比例Elong/Eshort=0.50；這不是適用所有內襯的固定係數。
factsEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: An effective measured thickness6mm against a10mm reference gives6/10=0.60, or60% retention. This is not60% retained capacity or proof of minimum design thickness.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For E=3000MPa, ν=0.30 and t/D=0.01, pcr=2E/(1−ν²)(t/D)³=0.00659MPa=6.59kPa. This is not an allowable field external pressure.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For p=0.6MPa, D=0.3m and t=0.006m, σθ=pD/(2t)=15MPa. Use consistent length units and separately establish long-term allowable material stress.

Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With material and other conditions fixed, reducing thickness from6mm to5mm gives bending-stiffness ratio Dnew/Dold=(5/6)³=0.579, or57.9% retention. Here D denotes plate flexural rigidity.

Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For total uncured reaction enthalpy Htotal=200J/g and residual Hres=20J/g, conversion α=1−Hres/Htotal=0.90. Both must use the same formulation and compatible test procedures.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If Eshort=3000MPa and Elong=1500MPa at the relevant design duration, Elong/Eshort=0.50. This is not a universal reduction factor for all liners.

procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條系統路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出埋深或斷面、地質水文、支護系統與施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which system path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in depth or section, ground and groundwater, support system and construction method.
pitfalls: 把四捨五入的公開數據當成設計值或允收值使用。
沒有確認規範版本、適用地區與荷載組合就直接套用另一國的條文。
pitfallsEn: Using rounded public figures as design or acceptance values.
Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

guides.title: 機制、算例與驗證：管道原位固化內襯
guides.titleEn: Mechanisms, calculations and verification: Cured-in-place pipe lining
guides.concept: 本課聚焦連結內襯幾何、固化證據與長期外壓及水理效能。十個單元依序辨識作用機制、量化假設、驗證程序與故障徵兆，讓學徒追蹤從原始資料到工程判斷的每一環。每個算例都帶單位與限制，不把局部成功或單一比值當成完整系統合格。交接須保留基準、異常與權責工程師核准的條件。
guides.conceptEn: This course focuses on connect liner geometry and cure evidence with long term external pressure and hydraulic performance. Ten units connect mechanisms, numerical assumptions, verification procedures and failure symptoms so apprentices can trace each inference from evidence to judgment. Every example includes units and limitations; one successful observation or ratio does not establish system acceptance. Handover retains datums, anomalies and conditions approved by the responsible engineer.
procedure: 原位固化內襯需要確認結構性厚度，內膜、樹脂富集層與原管壁不一定都可計入。厚度比例只是幾何指標，承載還取決於材料、缺陷、橢圓度及原管支承狀態。假設量得有效厚度6mm、參照原厚10mm，保留比例6/10=0.60即60%；這不是保留60%承載力，也不代表滿足最小設計厚度。若試片只取厚實的管頂而避開皺褶或薄區，平均值會掩蓋局部薄弱；用厚度比例取代屈曲與強度分析，可能錯誤延長失效管段的使用。

外水壓可使內襯向內屈曲，薄環模型展示厚徑比的立方敏感度。此模型是均勻圓環且無側向拘束的理想彈性上限尺度，實際設計須另考慮長期模數、橢圓及土體互制。假設E=3000MPa、ν=0.30、t/D=0.01，pcr=2E/(1−ν²)(t/D)³=0.00659MPa=6.59kPa；這不是實際管線的許可外壓。初始扁平或局部脫空可讓屈曲先在薄區發生，短期材料試驗優良仍不能排除此模式；忽略長期蠕變會高估持續外水壓下的抵抗能力。
受壓供水管內襯與重力污水管的荷載情境不同，不能共用同一個簡化合格判定。薄壁環向拉應力假設內襯獨立承壓，端部、接管與水錘應另列局部及瞬態需求。取內壓p=0.6MPa、直徑D=0.3m、厚t=0.006m，σθ=pD/(2t)=15MPa；需使用一致長度單位，並另查材料長期允許應力。只按穩態壓力驗算會漏掉瞬變峰值，接管口又可能造成應力集中；內襯中段沒有滲漏不能證明端部連接及支管介面也具相同耐壓能力。
內襯彎曲剛度對厚度高度敏感，局部變薄的影響可能遠大於其面積比例。比較同材料與相同幾何的厚度變動才能隔離此效應，不能混入模數及直徑的變化。同材料其他條件固定時，厚度由6mm降為5mm，彎曲剛度比Dnew/Dold=(5/6)³=0.579，即約保留57.9%；D在此指板彎曲剛度。把厚度減少六分之一誤當剛度也只減少六分之一，會低估薄帶效應；薄帶若和橢圓長軸或皺褶重合，局部變形可能先主導整段失效。

固化不是只看表面硬化，樹脂反應可能因溫度分布、時間與材料混合而不同。熱分析估計反應進度是一種材料證據，仍需結合力學試驗與整段製程紀錄。假設未固化總反應焓Htotal=200J/g、試片殘餘焓Hres=20J/g，轉化率α=1−Hres/Htotal=0.90；兩者須同配方及相容測試程序。薄小試片可能比管底濕冷區固化充分，單一高轉化率會掩蓋整段差異；未固化區可降低剛度並增加浸出風險，表面硬度正常也不能排除。

聚合物內襯在持續荷載下產生蠕變，短期模數不能無條件延用到長期屈曲評估。折減值受樹脂、溫度、環境及試驗時間控制，須有相符的材料證據。假設短期模數Eshort=3000MPa、對應設計時間的長期模數Elong=1500MPa，比例Elong/Eshort=0.50；這不是適用所有內襯的固定係數。以另一配方或較低溫的數據替代現用材料，會高估長期剛度；初期驗收合格後仍可能隨蠕變失去外壓穩定，巡檢須重視逐年橢圓化。

內襯使管徑縮小但可改善粗糙度，兩種效應必須同時計入。滿流圓管的曼寧比值只適用坡度相同且均勻流，局部瓶頸、支管及淤積會使實際系統不同。固定坡度與滿流下Qnew/Qold=(nold/nnew)(Dnew/Dold)^(8/3)；取粗糙度比1.5、管徑比0.96，得1.5×0.96^(8/3)=1.345，約1.35。粗糙度改善若只採產品宣傳值，會高估流量；局部皺褶或支管開口縮小可造成回水，即使全長平均管徑與計算比值都看似有利。
重新開通支管必須辨識真實接入口，切除內襯的範圍同時關係水流、密封與剩餘結構。面積只是幾何量，接頭邊緣缺口及未密封環隙仍需獨立檢核。假設圓形支管直徑d=0.10m，開口面積A=πd²/4=0.00785m²；不能把此面積直接當切割尺寸或最小通流保證。錯位開孔會破壞內襯而沒有真正接通支管，過切又可能形成滲入通道；主線影像通順並不能取代每一支管的連通與密封證據。
施工期間旁通系統需要面對持續入流與設備中斷，儲量與抽送能力不能互相替代。簡單累積量適合辨識停機後果，實際應變仍受尖峰流量、上游容積及允許水位控制。假設入流Q=0.02m³/s、停機t=1800s且無出流，V=Qt=36m³；此為累積需求，不能直接推成安全撤離時間或容許停機時間。將日平均入流作最壞情境會低估暴雨或排放尖峰；儲槽名義容積若包含不可用死角，實際緩衝更小，可能導致上游溢流與施工中斷。
內襯交接應連結樹脂批次、施工記錄、取樣位置與試驗結果，讓後續缺陷能回溯到特定區段。可追溯比例只是文件完整性，不能代替材料與水理驗收。假設20段內襯中19段有完整可追溯鏈，比例19/20=95%；剩餘1段必須保持未結案，不能以整體比例豁免其驗收。如果試驗報告與現場管段只以模糊日期連結，其他批次的合格結果可能誤套；日後發現異常便難以界定檢查範圍，放大維修與停用成本。
procedureEn: CIPP assessment requires structural thickness; an inner film, resin-rich layer or host wall may not all count. Thickness ratio is a geometric indicator, while capacity also depends on material properties, defects, ovality and host-pipe support. An effective measured thickness6mm against a10mm reference gives6/10=0.60, or60% retention. This is not60% retained capacity or proof of minimum design thickness. Sampling only a thick crown avoids wrinkles or thin regions and conceals weakness. Replacing strength and buckling checks with a thickness ratio can wrongly extend the use of a deficient pipe section.

External water pressure can buckle a liner inward. The thin-ring model illustrates cubic sensitivity to thickness ratio for an ideal uniform circular elastic ring without lateral restraint; real design additionally requires long-term modulus, ovality and soil interaction. For E=3000MPa, ν=0.30 and t/D=0.01, pcr=2E/(1−ν²)(t/D)³=0.00659MPa=6.59kPa. This is not an allowable field external pressure. Initial flattening or local loss of support can initiate buckling in a thin region despite good short-term test results. Ignoring creep overestimates resistance to sustained external pressure.

A pressurized water-main liner and a gravity-sewer liner face different load cases. Thin-wall hoop stress assumes independent internal-pressure resistance; ends, laterals and water hammer create additional local and transient demands. For p=0.6MPa, D=0.3m and t=0.006m, σθ=pD/(2t)=15MPa. Use consistent length units and separately establish long-term allowable material stress. A steady-pressure check can miss transient peaks and stress concentrations at laterals. A leak-free central liner does not establish equivalent pressure capacity at end connections and branch interfaces.

Liner bending stiffness is highly sensitive to thickness, making local thinning more important than its area fraction suggests. Compare the same material and geometry to isolate this effect rather than mixing changes in modulus or diameter. With material and other conditions fixed, reducing thickness from6mm to5mm gives bending-stiffness ratio Dnew/Dold=(5/6)³=0.579, or57.9% retention. Here D denotes plate flexural rigidity. Assuming a one-sixth thickness reduction causes only one-sixth stiffness loss understates the effect. A thin band coinciding with ovality or wrinkling can control local deformation and segment failure.

Cure cannot be inferred solely from a hard surface. Temperature distribution, duration and mixing affect resin reaction. Thermal analysis provides one measure of reaction progress, which must be combined with mechanical tests and full-process records. For total uncured reaction enthalpy Htotal=200J/g and residual Hres=20J/g, conversion α=1−Hres/Htotal=0.90. Both must use the same formulation and compatible test procedures. A small specimen may cure more fully than a cold wet invert. One high conversion value can conceal spatial variation; undercured areas can lose stiffness and increase leaching despite acceptable surface hardness.

Polymeric liners creep under sustained load, so short-term modulus cannot automatically represent long-term buckling behaviour. Reduction depends on resin, temperature, environment and duration, requiring evidence applicable to the installed material. If Eshort=3000MPa and Elong=1500MPa at the relevant design duration, Elong/Eshort=0.50. This is not a universal reduction factor for all liners. Substituting another formulation or lower-temperature data can overestimate long-term stiffness. A liner passing initial acceptance may later lose external-pressure stability through creep, making progressive ovality important in inspection.

Lining reduces diameter while potentially improving roughness, so both effects matter. A full circular-pipe Manning ratio assumes equal slope and uniform flow; bottlenecks, laterals and deposits can make system behaviour different. For full uniform flow at fixed slope, Qnew/Qold=(nold/nnew)(Dnew/Dold)^(8/3). Ratios1.5 and0.96 give1.345, approximately1.35. Using an advertised roughness improvement can overestimate flow. A wrinkle or restricted lateral can cause backwater even when average diameter and the nominal ratio appear favourable.

Restoring laterals requires identifying the actual connection. Removing liner affects flow, sealing and remaining structure. Area is only a geometric quantity; edge notches and an unsealed annular gap require independent evaluation. For a circular lateral diameter d=0.10m, opening area A=πd²/4=0.00785m². This is neither a cutting instruction nor a guaranteed minimum flow area. A misplaced opening damages the liner without restoring the lateral, while overcutting creates leakage paths. A clear mainline image does not replace evidence of every branch's continuity and seal.

Temporary bypassing must handle continuing inflow and equipment interruptions. Storage and pumping capacity are not interchangeable. A simple accumulation estimate illustrates outage consequences, while peak flow, upstream volume and permitted levels govern the response plan. For Q=0.02m³/s, t=1800s and no outflow, V=Qt=36m³. This is accumulated demand, not an allowable shutdown or evacuation time. Using daily average inflow as a worst case misses storm or discharge peaks. Nominal storage including unusable volume reduces the real buffer further and can cause upstream overflow and interruption.

Handover links resin batches, process records, sample positions and test results so later defects can be traced to a specific segment. A traceability fraction measures documentation completeness, not material or hydraulic acceptance. If19 of20 sections have complete traceability, the fraction is95%. The remaining section stays unresolved; the overall percentage cannot waive its acceptance requirements. Loose date-only links can assign a passing result to the wrong batch. Later anomalies then cannot be bounded to specific sections, increasing inspection, repair and outage costs.
evidence: 交接剩餘厚度判讀時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。按位置與周向建立厚度分布，區分結構層及不可計入的內膜，記錄試片取樣方向。將最薄區與設計要求及長期材料試驗對照，不能只以平均厚度驗收。
交接理想薄環屈曲時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。量測實際橢圓度、環隙及厚度，取得對應時間與溫度的材料模數，再以適用設計方法評估。將理想環結果僅作量級交叉檢查，不能代替工程師核定的設計。
交接內壓環向應力時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。比對實際壓力歷程與端部密封構造，依合格試驗方案核對材料及系統能力。試驗壓力、隔離及排氣由責任工程師制定，本算例不構成現場加壓程序。
交接厚度立方敏感度時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。依厚度圖辨識連續薄帶，再將其位置與外壓、缺陷及支承狀態疊合。採代表性試片取得模數，並把局部剛度差納入分析而非只檢查平均材料值。
交接固化反應證據時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。比對取樣點與施工溫度歷程，核對試驗基線、樣品質量與樹脂配方，另查彎曲模數和玻璃轉移行為。固化驗收依材料供應與設計核准規格，不採通用百分比。
evidenceEn: When handing over remaining thickness interpretation, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Map thickness by location and circumference, distinguishing structural layers from excluded film and recording specimen orientation. Compare thin regions with design requirements and long-term material tests rather than accepting on average thickness alone.

When handing over ideal thin ring buckling, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Measure ovality, annular gap and thickness, obtain modulus for the relevant duration and temperature, and use an applicable design method. The ideal ring result is only an order-of-magnitude cross-check, not an approved design.

When handing over internal pressure hoop stress, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Compare actual pressure histories and end seals, checking material and system performance under an approved test plan. The responsible engineer sets pressure, isolation and venting procedures; this example does not authorize field pressurization.

When handing over cubic thickness sensitivity, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Identify continuous thin bands on the thickness map and relate them to pressure, defects and support. Obtain modulus from representative samples and include local stiffness differences rather than checking average material values alone.

When handing over evidence of cure reaction, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Relate sample location to temperature history, checking baseline, sample mass and resin formulation. Review flexural modulus and glass-transition behaviour as well; cure acceptance follows approved material and design specifications, not a universal percentage.
pitfalls: 若試片只取厚實的管頂而避開皺褶或薄區，平均值會掩蓋局部薄弱；用厚度比例取代屈曲與強度分析，可能錯誤延長失效管段的使用。
只按穩態壓力驗算會漏掉瞬變峰值，接管口又可能造成應力集中；內襯中段沒有滲漏不能證明端部連接及支管介面也具相同耐壓能力。
薄小試片可能比管底濕冷區固化充分，單一高轉化率會掩蓋整段差異；未固化區可降低剛度並增加浸出風險，表面硬度正常也不能排除。
粗糙度改善若只採產品宣傳值，會高估流量；局部皺褶或支管開口縮小可造成回水，即使全長平均管徑與計算比值都看似有利。
將日平均入流作最壞情境會低估暴雨或排放尖峰；儲槽名義容積若包含不可用死角，實際緩衝更小，可能導致上游溢流與施工中斷。
pitfallsEn: Sampling only a thick crown avoids wrinkles or thin regions and conceals weakness. Replacing strength and buckling checks with a thickness ratio can wrongly extend the use of a deficient pipe section.

A steady-pressure check can miss transient peaks and stress concentrations at laterals. A leak-free central liner does not establish equivalent pressure capacity at end connections and branch interfaces.

A small specimen may cure more fully than a cold wet invert. One high conversion value can conceal spatial variation; undercured areas can lose stiffness and increase leaching despite acceptable surface hardness.
Using an advertised roughness improvement can overestimate flow. A wrinkle or restricted lateral can cause backwater even when average diameter and the nominal ratio appear favourable.
Using daily average inflow as a worst case misses storm or discharge peaks. Nominal storage including unusable volume reduces the real buffer further and can cause upstream overflow and interruption.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的隧道與地下設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring tunnels and underground works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 頂管中繼推進站
related.transfer: 可遷移「剩餘厚度判讀」與「水理容量比較」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；頂管中繼推進站的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Remaining thickness interpretation" and "Hydraulic capacity comparison" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Intermediate jacking stations must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦連結內襯幾何、固化證據與長期外壓及水理效能；頂管中繼推進站則以頂管中繼站的分段受力、行程相容與局部接觸為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on connect liner geometry and cure evidence with long term external pressure and hydraulic performance; Intermediate jacking stations centres on intermediate-jacking segment forces, stroke compatibility and local contact, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「剩餘厚度判讀」與「分段推力與反力連續」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到頂管中繼推進站，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「曲線管列與徑向作用」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Remaining thickness interpretation” and “Segment thrust and reaction continuity”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Intermediate jacking stations, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Curved pipe strings and radial action", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 管道原位固化內襯
history.text: 本課以公開工程研究與機構文件建立連結內襯幾何、固化證據與長期外壓及水理效能的背景。美國環保署出版污水收集系統復健技術報告（2010）。美國環保署出版丹佛與哥倫布內襯回溯研究（2011）。美國環保署出版克里夫蘭供水管示範評估（2012）。兩個地標用來比較環境、量測與維護證據，並非宣稱本課每一教學構件都實際用於兩處。來源若只可讀摘要，適用範圍已另行註明；現場設計須重新確認規範版本與責任。本課只重建公開原理。
history.textEn: This course uses public research and institutional documents to establish context for connect liner geometry and cure evidence with long term external pressure and hydraulic performance. US EPA publishes its wastewater rehabilitation technology report (2010). US EPA publishes the Denver and Columbus retrospective liner study (2011). US EPA publishes the Cleveland water-main demonstration evaluation (2012). The two landmarks compare environments, measurements and maintenance evidence; they do not imply that every teaching component was installed at both sites. Abstract-only access is declared in source scopes. Field design requires current applicability and responsible review. This course reconstructs public principles only.
